items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-09-08
items.q: I found out that that wasn't Rene. That's Rena. R-E-N-A, Rena.

ctx.x: Well, you see, I found out that that wasn't Rene. That's Rena. R-E-N-A, Rena. That E said the sound of A. R-E-N-A, Rene. I dropped the A, yeah, yeah.
So you dropped the A, huh? Yeah.
